note: Hand-captured on release day by parsing the notes' raw HTML to text, not by summarizing them. A balance patch: the devs state it targets outliers since Bloodtide, with larger changes held for 1.18. Eternal attributions are verified against data/game-data/eternals.json, since the notes head these sections with bare blessing names and never name most of the Eternals. Baron Valmont is in this patch but absent from every measured source we hold: our stats pipeline reads its hero list from the omeda roster, frozen since 2026-08-28, so we never ask pred.gg about him.
global: Valmont gets a broad power cut three weeks after release, with the devs writing that they deliberately overshoot a new hero's strength and overshot his.
Revenant, who the notes call the pinnacle of the carry role, loses trading power, late scaling and the stat steal on his ultimate.
Crucible 3v3 drops its custom damage and durability modifiers entirely — heroes now use their live 5v5 values in the mode.
Weald is trimmed a third straight patch, this time at the Major: missile base damage 8 -> 7 and the on-hit modifier 30% -> 20%.
The defensive minor row comes down together — Immaculate, Dampening and Patina all lose value on the same day.
Shadow's Eve dresses Sanctuary for Halloween: new lighting, jack o' lanterns and candles, with no gameplay change stated.

tldr.lead: Valmont was overtuned and the devs said so
tldr.text: Lilith's damage, Rupture, the ultimate and both augments all come down. The notes explain they ship new heroes slightly over-strong to cover the learning curve, and that this time they went too far.

tldr.lead: The carry pecking order gets rearranged
tldr.text: Revenant and Drongo take real cuts at the top while Murdock and TwinBlast get the stats they needed. The notes name Revenant and Drongo as the reason the other two were stuck.

tldr.lead: Crucible stops being a different game balance-wise
tldr.text: The custom damage, healing and damage-taken modifiers are gone, so 3v3 now runs on live 5v5 numbers. Stacking items and hero passives also work there now.

tldr.lead: Weald finally takes a Major cut
tldr.text: After two patches of trimming only the minors, the missiles themselves lose damage: base 8 -> 7 and the on-hit modifier 30% -> 20%. Taproot drops again too.

tldr.lead: Defensive minors all shrink at once
tldr.text: Immaculate 12% -> 10%, Dampening 12% -> 10%, Patina's shield down at every level, Lotus max health 1.5% -> 1.25%. Stat-check durability is the theme being hit.

tldr.lead: Bruisers who had fallen off get real help
tldr.text: Bayle gains attack speed growth, armor growth and movement speed plus scaling across his kit. Terra's Highland Hurl finally shreds armor on a rank curve, and Sevarog's hitboxes stop fighting him.

systems.name: Crucible 3v3: damage modifiers removed
systems.summary: Heroes no longer have adjusted damage output, healing and shielding output or damage-taken modifiers in Crucible. They use their live 5v5 values. The modifiers were designed for 5v5 ARAM and translated badly to 3v3.

systems.name: Crucible 3v3: stacking and pacing
systems.summary: Recall 8s -> 7s. Sevarog and Renna now gain passive stacks there as they do elsewhere; stacking items such as Overlord now gain stacks passively and stacking crests gain multiple charges per use, matching ARAM. Bottomless Vial's magical power per river buff is corrected 15 -> 5 in the mode.

systems.name: Shadow's Eve map
systems.summary: Sanctuary gets a Halloween dressing — new lighting, jack o' lanterns and candles. No gameplay change is stated.

eternals.summary: No new Eternals. This is a durability pass: Weald takes its first Major cut after two patches of minor trims, and the blessings that make a hero hard to kill — Immaculate, Dampening, Patina, Lotus's health — all come down together. Krix loses some of the bruiser damage that was making it beat Thraex.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: Major: missile base damage 8 -> 7, on-hit modifier 30% -> 20%. Taproot bonus physical power scaling 7% -> 6%.
changes.meaning: Third straight trim, and the first to touch the missiles themselves. The on-hit modifier is the bigger half: it was what made the execute scale with an on-hit build rather than just finish low targets.

changes.name: Krix
changes.change: Cannibalism max health on takedown 30 -> 25. Feeding Frenzy attack speed 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Aimed squarely at bruisers picking Krix over Thraex. The notes say there was not enough of a damage trade-off for how much more durable Krix made them.

changes.name: Knell
changes.change: Patina shield 35-290 (+15 per level) -> 30-268 (+14 per level). Dampening damage reduction 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Both of Knell's quiet defensive picks shrink. Dampening only reduces damage from enemies beyond 1100 units, and the notes admit it had been flying under the radar as an anti-poke tool.

changes.name: Lotus
changes.change: Major max health per roll 1.5% -> 1.25%. Immaculate damage reduction 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Lotus keeps its catch-all identity but stops doubling as a tank blessing. Immaculate's third consecutive cut keeps shaving the above-85%-health damage reduction that decides early all-ins.

changes.name: Aion
changes.meaning: A free-gold trim. The notes name Shinbi and Countess as heroes taking it purely to scale, since it pays out without ever interacting with an opponent.

items: Exodus (crest): Cooldown 90 -> 100; bugfix — its active can now be used while grounded or rooted.
Rift Walkers (crest): Rift Snatcher pull radius 550 -> 625.
Mutilator: Bugfix — now applies on AoE abilities that damage multiple enemies.
Vainglory: Magical armor 35 -> 40; In Vain bonus max stack armors +10% -> +12%.
Crests: Bugfix — automatic basic attacks (Legion, Eden) no longer stack a crest on the first shot only.

itemChanges.name: Exodus
itemChanges.change: Cooldown 90 -> 100, undoing an earlier buff; bugfix means its active now works while grounded or rooted. Popular in North America as a fight-disrupting pickup.

itemChanges.name: Rift Walkers
itemChanges.change: Rift Snatcher pull radius 550 -> 625, reversing most of an old range cut the devs say left it out of favour.

itemChanges.name: Onixian Quiver
itemChanges.change: Multishot damage 8-30% -> 10-35% — a carry answer to close-range divers.

itemChanges.name: Mutilator
itemChanges.change: Bugfix: it now applies on AoE abilities that hit several enemies, instead of only single-target hits.

itemChanges.name: Azure Core
itemChanges.change: Ability haste 15 -> 10, to stop it being the default mage first buy over Oathkeeper and Soulbinder.

itemChanges.name: Luxforge Lantern
itemChanges.change: Physical power 30 -> 35, catching up with support items that were bumped earlier.

itemChanges.name: Flux Matrix
itemChanges.change: Ability haste 10 -> 15, named as a magical-armor option for Aurora, Shinbi and Kwang.

itemChanges.name: Vainglory
itemChanges.change: Magical armor 35 -> 40; In Vain bonus max stack armors +10% -> +12%, so the armor-stacking capstone pays more.
